cases.notes: PARSER_EVAL_METHODOLOGY.md's kuusi/tuli/voi ambiguity slice is explicitly Finnish-first (see 'Start Finnish-first, then add Estonian parity cases'). This ET case exercises the real custom parser on Estonian sentences covering the same three concepts (spruce/six, fire/came, butter/may) and documents which collapse translates to Estonian (tuli) and which does not (kuusk vs kuus is not a collision in ET orthography). A dedicated ET-native ambiguity slice with its own homograph pairs is still pending; this fixture is a starting point, not a replacement for that work.
